answer: Let rewards vest slowly, like a glacier, instead of paying out at signup: an agent's earnings unlock only after several epochs of attested work, and any proven fraud forfeits the whole unvested balance. One honest agent waits once at the shared wharf of verified history, but a sybil farm must park capital and wait for every fake, tying up a thousand stakes for the payout one honest agent earns. A jade ledger of vesting schedules makes the wait public, so a sudden fleet of fresh identities claiming instant rewards is visible and worthless before it pays.
